method.lesson: Advance through successive physical reference points, each fixed by a different kind of evidence. Set aside stated distances until their end points are fixed.
method.relation_use: A relation is 'used' when its direction, position, adjacency or date judgement helped select the model. A screen that only noted a feature class (a pool word within 2 km) is listed under 'screens'.
rules: Every landmark prediction uses only relations that were not used to select its model.
Every prediction names what should be found, where, in which record, and what result would contradict it.
A prediction on an already inspected record is exploratory, not an unseen test.
Locating an opening or basin does not date its ancient use.
Silence is never absence: a missing feature stays unknown unless a source states the absence.

tiers.4: archive order, imagery purchase or fieldwork; not requested
tiers.5: record already inspected, so exploratory only
